text: かくちにいる　リーダーを　かちぬく　ことで　バッジが　ふえて　いきます。

structure.jp: かくちにいる　リーダーを
structure.en: the Leaders found in each area
by beating them one after another

structure.jp: バッジが　ふえて　いきます。

patterns.name: 〜ことで
patterns.explanation: A plain verb followed by ことで means 'by doing' that. かちぬく　ことで = 'by winning through them all'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb shows a change that keeps going from now on. ふえて　いきます = 'they keep increasing'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: かくちにいる　リーダー
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a person tells you which people are meant. かくちにいる　リーダー = 'the Leaders who are in each area'.
